scenario: Peacekeeping interpreter shortlisting requires candidates to demonstrate high language fluency OR strong field composure. The two traits are independent in the candidate pool; among shortlisted interpreters the OR-gate creates a negative collider correlation.

data.description: Population base rates and OR-gate selection mechanism

values.selection_rule: OR gate: selected if language fluency OR field composure

question: (a) What is P(selected)? (b) What is P(language_fluency|not_field_composure, selected)? (c) What is P(language_fluency|field_composure, selected)? (d) Explain why language fluency and field composure appear negatively correlated among selected candidates even though they are independent in the population.

ground_truth.explanation: Under OR-gate selection, a candidate lacking field composure must have language fluency to be selected (P=1.0). A candidate who has field composure is selected regardless of language fluency, so P(language fluency | field composure, selected) = P(language fluency) = 0.42. This differential probability creates a negative within-selected correlation despite population independence.

naive_answer: The negative correlation among selected candidates reflects a genuine inverse relationship between language fluency and field composure in the domain.
naive_trap: The negative correlation is entirely an artefact of OR-gate collider selection, not a real population-level relationship between the two traits.
reasoning_trace: (1) P(sel)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)=0.42+0.48-0.42×0.48=0.6984. (2) If not-B and selected, must have A → P(A|not-B,sel)=1.0. (3) If B and selected, selection is independent of A → P(A|B,sel)=P(A)=0.42. (4) The gap between 1.0 and 0.42 produces a negative association within the selected group via collider bias.
python_verification:
pA,pB = 0.42,0.48
pSel = pA+pB-pA*pB
assert abs(pSel-0.6984)<0.005
pA_notB_sel = pA*(1-pB)/(pA*(1-pB))   # =1.0
assert abs(pA_notB_sel-1.0)<0.005
pA_B_sel = pA*pB/pB                    # =pA
assert abs(pA_B_sel-pA)<0.005
assert pA_notB_sel > pA_B_sel          # negative collider bias confirmed
